meta.title: Compute point index map lazily
meta.body_summary: Remove stored alt->point-idxs in alt-table and compute lazily via invert-index, claiming behavior unchanged.

perf_labels.notes: Codex PR attempted lazy index computation; maintainer tested and found substantial runtime increase, then closed and junked the PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 44 changed lines in a single file, this is a tiny refactor by absolute volume. It fits a micro-optimization but was closed because the lazy computation approach introduced a runtime regression rather than improving performance.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer pavpanchekha tested the change and reported that alt->point-idxs is called often, so lazy computation (invert-index) causes a substantial runtime increase.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid storing alt->point-idxs for memory savings; only needed in one place, so compute on demand.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer tested and found runtime increase; closed with note that Codex PRs will be junked if not working.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent removed a stored index to save memory but failed to account for frequent access patterns, causing a performance regression; demonstrates limitation in understanding runtime trade-offs without profiling data.

detection_detail.code_reading: pavpanchekha reviewed the lazy computation logic and its usage frequency in the alt-table.
detection_detail.load_test: Manually tested the branch and observed a substantial runtime increase.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Maintainer's comment states observed runtime increase but provides no before/after numbers or measurement method.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; maintainer explicitly decided to junk Codex PRs that don't work out.

core_change_summary.description: In src/core/alt-table.rkt, removed the alt->point-idxs hash table and inlined an invert-index computation to compute point indices lazily; only one place uses it.
change_trajectory: Single commit inlines invert-index and removes stored index map.

review_signals.summary: Observed that alt->point-idxs is called frequently, so lazy computation increases runtime; noted that done? and cost tables are not reliable for determining active alts.
Decided to junk Codex PRs when they don't work out because remaking is cheap.

collaboration_trajectory: Codex opened PR with a single commit refactoring alt-table.
Maintainer tested and reported performance regression via PR comment.
Maintainer closed PR with comment about junking failed Codex attempts.
